title: MEATER Carryover Overshoot by Protein
app: Meater probes, Anova Precision Cooker sessions, Instant Pot logs, wine-fridge sensors, ESPHome kitchen sensors, and pantry inventory feeds via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=meater:cook
| stats avg(carryover_delta_c) as avg_carryover_delta_c, max(carryover_delta_c) as max_carryover_delta_c by protein
| where avg_carryover_delta_c>4 OR max_carryover_delta_c>8
| sort - avg_carryover_delta_c
description: Uses MEATER cook telemetry telemetry to monitor how much temperatures rise after food leaves the heat in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for proteins that keep overshooting target doneness, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest MEATER cook telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Protein table of average and max carryover rise.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how much temperatures rise after food leaves the heat so you can spot proteins that keep overshooting target doneness before it becomes annoying.
